query:
SELECT id, claim_number, status, workflow_state, 
       ai_assessment_triggered, ai_assessment_completed,
       document_processing_status,
       ai_assessment_started_at, ai_assessment_completed_at,
       updated_at
FROM claims
WHERE id = 5850001;

SELECT id, claim_id, created_at, updated_at 
FROM ai_assessments 
WHERE claim_id = 5850001
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3;
